items.evidence: python work/hold_the_gate.py headless --seed 1 --ticks 0 --settings s1.json printed {"tick":0,"screen":"title","menu_index":0,"language":"en","volume":5,"texts":["Hold the gate","Start","Settings","Quit"],"score":0,"wave":1,"gate_health":5,"guard_y":6.0,"walkers":[],"bolts":[]}; all brief keys present; tick equals ticks run.
--frame f_title.png (and 10+ other frames) wrote PNGs; IHDR reads 800 x 480; images open and show the scene.
Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; script 2:down,4:enter -> screen settings; 0:enter -> screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5.
In Settings, 8 x right from 5 -> 10, 15 x right -> 10, 15 x left -> 0; texts show 'Volume: 10'/'Volume: 0'.

Settings, down, right -> language es, texts [Configuración, Volumen: 5, Idioma: Español, Volver] (all 4 changed); Back -> title [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Configuración, Salir]; play [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5]; paused/lost also Spanish; frames show the Spanish with accents.
Run with --settings p1.json set volume 3 and language; next run with p1.json started volume 3 and same language (also es persisted to the next run's title); fresh.json run started volume 5, en.
Holding up 30 ticks: guard_y 6.0 -> 9.0 (6/s); 60 ticks -> 12.0; 300 ticks up -> 12.0, 300 ticks down -> 0.0 (clamped to field edges).
Shoot held from tick 11: a new bolt appears only at ticks 12, 36, 60, 84 (every 24); bolts advance 5.6 per 24 ticks (14/s); a single bolt at x 19.9667 is gone the next tick (never reported past 20).
Seed 1 after Enter: walkers spawn at x 20 on steps 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 (every 90 ticks), lanes 4,10,2,6,2, no 6th; each moves 2.25 per 90 ticks (1.5/s) leftward.
Guard moved to y 4, one bolt: walker health 2 -> 1 and bolt removed at tick 89, score 0; second bolt: walker removed at tick 115, score 10. Bolt at y 5 or y 6 passes walker at y 4 (health stays 2).

Idle play: first walker at x 0 at tick 801, gone and gate 5 -> 4 at 802; next -> 3 at 892; gate 0 at tick 1162 -> screen lost, texts [You lost, Final score: 0, Enter: title]; with 5 kills then idle: lost, 'Final score: 50'.

Bot run seed 1: wave 1's last walker gone at tick 526, wave becomes 2 at 706 and first wave-2 walker at 707 (180 ticks = 3 s); 7 walkers in wave 2 (count 7 at ticks 1250 and 1340); texts 'Wave 2 of 5' / Spanish 'Oleada 2 de 5'.
Bot script (5605 ticks, seed 1) via CLI: screen won, score 450, gate 5, texts [You won, Final score: 450, Enter: title]; adding enter at 5700 -> screen title.

Escape at tick 300: states at 301 and 600 identical (walkers, bolts, guard_y, score), holding up while paused does not move guard; Enter on Resume -> play, walkers at 601 equal the unpaused run at 301; down + Enter on Title -> title screen.
Same seed/ticks/script (3000-tick bot script) twice -> identical JSON; seed 2 differs. Wave-1 lanes: seed1 [4,10,2,6,2], seed2 [2,2,2,6,4], seed3 [4,10,10,4,6], seed7 [6,4,8,2,2].

Frame at tick 2400 of the bot run: walkers (14.075,6),(16.325,4),(18.575,10) drawn at px (563,240),(653,320),(743,80); bolts at (743,160),(332,240),(108,240); guard at x 80, y 240; gate bar on the left; HUD 'SCORE: 180  WAVE 3 OF 5  GATE: 5' (and Spanish version).

Title frames show the menu with '>' and yellow on the chosen entry (Start, and Quit after down,down); settings frames mark Language in English and Idioma: Español in Spanish; Spanish title frame shows Defiende la puerta / Empezar / Configuración / Salir.

Strings live in work/lang/en.json and work/lang/es.json (loaded by load_languages); code uses keys only; README 'Add a language' section explains copying lang/en.json to lang/<code>.json, and notes font glyph limits.
README has a Play section (keys, rules) and exact headless and --frame commands; both ran as written (paths adjusted to call the script from my scratch folder) and produced JSON and an 800x480 PNG.

defects: The JSON is printed in the console code page when piped on Windows (cp1252 here), not UTF-8: Spanish output (e.g. 'Configuración') fails to decode as UTF-8; a reader must use the locale encoding.
On won/lost screens the frame still draws the HUD (Score/Wave/Gate top bar), but 'texts' lists only the three overlay strings, so texts is not every string on screen.
A bolt fired exactly 0.6 units off a lane (guard_y reported 4.6 after 14 down ticks) misses because of float drift; the 'within 0.6' edge is not inclusive in practice.
Guard can sit at y = 0 or y = 12, so half of its sprite is drawn outside the field at the edges.
README's first headless example ('5:down,6:enter,...') opens Settings rather than starting play, so its shoot/escape inputs do nothing; misleading as an example.
The tkinter play window was not checked (the builder's README says it was never opened, and judge rules forbid opening it).

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4
